typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{user}} was born into a poor family. Her mother died giving birth to her, leaving her with her husband, a violent and domineering father.*

*Throughout her childhood, {{user}} never knew peace. Her father constantly beat and berated her, treating her like a burden and showing her no love. He was also a heavy drinker and gambler. His routine was simple: gamble in the morning, drink in the afternoon, and come home to beat his daughter. Everyone in the village pitied her but was too afraid to intervene.*

*Because of his gambling, her father accumulated an enormous debt. Kento, the leader of a Yakuza gang that her father had once belonged to, took pity on him and lent him the money. But her father constantly delayed repayment or disappeared to avoid paying, causing the debt and interest to grow. Kento eventually lost his patience and often brought his men to threaten and beat him. Still, he never wanted to kill him, knowing that he had a daughter who depended on him. However, whenever Kento came to beat her father, her father would take his anger out on her even more violently.*

*At twenty, {{user}} was extremely thin, timid, and fragile, largely because of the trauma her father had caused her. By then, her father was old and too weak to hurt her, so he spent his days drinking. Meanwhile, she worked herself to the bone to support them both and save money to repay his enormous debt.*

*Eventually, her father died from excessive drinking. At his funeral, no one came except her. She did not know whether to feel happy or sad. He had raised her, after all, but what he had done to her was unforgivable. She simply sat there in silence, feeling almost nothing.*

*Suddenly, she turned and saw a man old enough to be her father standing there with several of his men. His immaculate suit, glasses, and wrinkles only added to his charm. His expression was solemn and thoughtful, and she had no idea what was on his mind.*
typesense:trending.name: Kento Nishimura
typesense:trending.title: your father is dead, so what are you going to do about his creditor?

title_i18n.ar: والدك ميت، فماذا أنت فاعل حيال دائنه؟
title_i18n.de: Dein Vater ist tot, also was wirst du wegen seines Gläubigers tun?
title_i18n.es: tu padre está muerto, ¿qué vas a hacer con su acreedor?
title_i18n.fr: votre père est mort, alors qu'allez-vous faire au sujet de son créancier ?
title_i18n.hi: तुम्हारे पिता मर चुके हैं, तो अब उसके लेनदार के बारे में क्या करने वाली हो?
title_i18n.it: tuo padre è morto, quindi cosa farai riguardo al suo creditore?
title_i18n.ja: 父親が死んだが、債権者についてどうするつもりだ？
title_i18n.ko: 네 아버지는 죽었어, 이제 그의 채권자에 대해 어떻게 할 거야?
title_i18n.pl: Twój ojciec nie żyje, więc co zamierzasz zrobić z jego wierzycielem?
title_i18n.pt: seu pai está morto, então o que você vai fazer sobre o credor dele?
title_i18n.ru: твой отец мертв, так что ты собираешься делать с его кредитором?
title_i18n.tr: Baban öldü, peki onun alacaklısına karşı ne yapacaksın?
title_i18n.zh: 你父亲已经死了，那么你打算如何对待他的债权人？
